newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish industry output grows one pct y/y in Aug.
newsitem.headline: Turkish industry output grows one pct y/y in Aug.

text.p: Turkey's industrial production grew one percent in Augustyear on year, down from 13.5 percent in the same 1995 month and from 4.3 percent in July this year, the State Institute of Statistics said.
It said the output was up by 5.7 percent in the first eight months against a 8.6 percent growth in the same 1995 period.

It said the mining sector, which shrunk by 1.5 percent in the January-August 1995, grew by 3.4 percent in the same period this year. The manufacturing industry growth was 5.1 percent, down from 8.9 percent a year ago.
The utility sector including electricity, gas and water grew by 10.8 percent against 10.6 percent in January-August.
